title: Validate composed reviews against the expected leaf worklist
summary: Composed review validation now enforces that selected leaf worklists are executed in order and completeness is verified through expected manifests, preventing inconsistent reports that omit required domains.
key_points: Add optional manifest validation to confirm all selected leaves are returned in correct order with matching versions
Reject duplicate producers and reject partial reports when all leaves should be returned
Distinguish budget exhaustion from configuration incompatibility in skip reasons
Coverage calculation sums non-failed leaf worklists, not slot count
Manifest-free callers still supported but cannot certify completeness
